_about: Each model keeps one character voice in every video (owner, 2026-10-22: long-term viewers remember them). Keys are the model's short name as the game records it; values are a locked voice in '3 Werewolf TTS/characters'. Game 1 (3880b590) set the first six; a model that is new to the videos gets its seat's voice in its first game, or an unused one if that voice already belongs to another model (director/episode.py adds it here). Game 3 (c0416225, owner 2026-10-27): earlier choices stay; the two new Chinese models got random unused voices (never Hugo, the Texas rancher). Rule (owner, 2026-10-27): only a model new to the videos gets a voice, always one no model has yet, so no two models ever share a voice.
